title: Menu Bar Has No Mac Glyphs
description: Verifies that the menu bar never displays Mac key glyphs in any toggle state.
given: Menu bar with all three toggle states (panel, terminal, fullscreen off and on)
then: No Mac glyphs appear in any combination
impl_ref: src/shell/accelerators.test.ts::the menu bar holds no Mac glyph, in any of its toggle states
